column1: # The golangci-lint classes corpus, emitted shape (PR #4515, finding F-210).
# tables/ with the compiler's public API and holds every row: the number of
# lines of <file> that match <pattern> (a Go regexp, one line at a time) is at
# least <min> and at most <max>. A `0 0` row is a shape the fix removed; the
# rows beside it are the shape that replaced it. The linter half of the same
# corpus is lint.ratchet.tsv, run by make schema-go-generated-golangci-lint-gate.
# errcheck, flat packet runs: each chunk's stream call discards its sticky
# error explicitly and the run checks stream.Err() once.
# G115, same-width signed lanes: reads through getI8..getI64, writes through
# putI64 or a masked same-width store, never a bare signed/unsigned cast.
# G115, narrowing: a 64-bit value behind a runtime wire kind lands in a
# narrower field with a folded mask (unsigned) or the kind check's #nosec
# (signed), never a bare narrowing cast. The bare casts left are the 14 whose
# v was read at the field's own width (v := r.getI16(), r.Get16(), ...), where
# the conversion narrows nothing; the 10 behind r.Signed(kind) and
# r.Unsigned(kind) are the masked and #nosec rows above them.
